children.text: Stanford accepts fewer than 4% of applicants, and the vast majority of them look qualified on paper. Join Brennan, a former Stanford admissions reader, for a rare inside look at what actually separates admitted students from the thousands of equally impressive applicants who are denied. You'll learn why "well-rounded" is often the wrong strategy, what Stanford readers are really looking for beyond grades and test scores, and how a single unmistakable thread is what makes a file memorable. Whether your student is early in the process or already building a Stanford-focused application, this session will show you exactly what it takes to stand out at one of the most selective schools in the country.
In this webinar, you'll learn:
Why "Well-Rounded" Loses:
Stanford isn't looking for students who do everything well — they're looking for one thing done exceptionally. Brennan explains why breadth often works against strong applicants.
What Readers Remember:
With thousands of qualified files, readers remember the ones with a clear, specific throughline. Learn what makes a Stanford application memorable versus forgettable.
The Story Has to Be Undeniable:
Grades and scores get a student in the room—they don't get them admitted. Get the framework for building an application with one clear, unmistakable narrative.

meta.description: Florida families often approach UF, Florida State, and the University of Miami with the same admissions strategy. That can be a costly mistake.

children.text: Getting into a top Florida college takes more than strong grades and a long activities list—especially when UF, Florida State, and the University of Miami are looking for different things. Join Denard Jones, Empowerly Lead Counselor and former admissions officer, where he’ll break down how each school approaches academics, testing, activities, essays, timing, and application strategy. You’ll learn why rigor and the academic record carry so much weight at UF, how trajectory and program selection can shape the FSU process, and why storytelling and demonstrated interest matter more at Miami. For Florida families—and out-of-state students targeting these schools—understanding those differences can mean the difference between simply applying and building a strategy around how your student will actually be read.
In this webinar, you'll learn:
Three Schools, Three Admissions Playbooks:
UF, Florida State, and Miami can evaluate the exact same student very differently. Learn what each school prioritizes and why one application strategy should not be used across all three.
Academics, Testing & Activities That Actually Matter:
See how course rigor, senior-year trajectory, test scores, intended major, activities, and even Florida-specific requirements can change how competitive a student looks.
Build the Right Application for Each School:

Discover when the academic record needs to do the persuading, when a student’s story becomes critical, and how families can make smarter decisions about timing, essays, engagement, and college-list strategy.
